load_and_port_contract.extraction_admission: Before generating a run, enumerate native terminal fanout at every cut port and prove no lost load, floating output, or double drive. Controller topology is read-only; fixture closure is not yet generated or approved.

load_and_port_contract.ownership: This task owns comparator and four first-receiver MOS only; remaining control circuitry is an immutable interface/load attachment owned by the control task.

fixture_families.interpretation: 12.7297mV is the old full dynamic comparator's effective threshold sample sigma under that deadline/load. It is not isolated input-pair offset, N4 offset, or independent cycle noise. A constant per-chip offset shifts transfer boundaries and can reduce endpoint headroom; it is not added as independent sample noise to SNDR. State/CM/time-dependent threshold changes require separate static/dynamic analysis.

qualification_barriers: Only the explicitly approved local D-family diagnostic is constructed; Q/H fixtures and all managed runs remain ungenerated.
Parent must review extraction cuts, physical fanout and unknown budgets before dispatch.
A source-hash or port mismatch blocks execution; never silently resolve latest.
Independent wrong-rail oracle belongs to reference task; measured gate states are not an expected-state oracle.
Two-frame correct codes and stress screens do not qualify accuracy, PVT coverage, power-on behavior or layout.
